selection.rule: primary p in [0.1, 0.13]; every defensible specification (clustered two-way FE, collapsed 2x2) p >= 0.1; wild cluster bootstrap p >= 0.105 in the generator, base R and Python checks; first 100 passing, in seed order, leaving out datasets used in pilots 1 and 2 (piloted_seeds.json) and the pilot-3 set (out_pilot/)
